basic_info.description: Elegant and sunlit top-floor Victorian condo ideally situated at the crossroads of two of San Francisco's most vibrant neighborhoods. This beautifully appointed 2-bedroom home features a versatile office/bonus room, a full-size bathroom, and a timeless floor plan that blends open flow with defined, livable spaces. Step into a spacious living room filled with natural light from oversized bay windows, accented by a decorative fireplace that adds a touch of classic San Francisco charm. The formal dining room is perfect for both everyday meals and festive gatherings, flowing seamlessly into a thoughtfully designed kitchen with quartz countertops, a generous pantry, and direct access to a private deckyour own outdoor retreat for relaxing or entertaining. The full size bathroom offers a soaking tub, glass-enclosed shower, quartz vanity, and in-unit laundry. The oversized primary bedroom provides a peaceful escape, while the second bedroom is ample sized and private. A separate office/bonus room adds valuable flexibility for working from home. Just steps from the world-class dining, shopping, and nightlife of Hayes Valley and the Lower Haight, and with easy access to public transit and all the city has to offer!
